reviewer: primary assistant, direct pixels from all eight calibration sheets
scope: 96 uniformly sampled catalog IDs, seed 20260914; labels entered before v2 fitting or scoring
buildScale: 1 slender apparent build, 2 intermediate, 3 fuller/broader; half steps are between adjacent anchors; null when no useful overall impression survives clothing or pose
shapeScale: shoulderHip: -1 hips broader, 0 similar, 1 shoulders broader; waist: 0 straighter, 1 moderate indentation, 2 pronounced; null means not judged
limitations: Subjective single-reviewer visual targets, not measured anatomy, clothing size, demographics or health. Ordinary clothing permits approximate build judgments. Shape axes require more local evidence. No leg labels. Sample-index mapping is calibration-ids.json.
